name: eyeconic-main
description: Eyeconic website (client/ + server/). The integrated /dashboard serves all quiz/analytics data through the website server's /api/app/* proxy, which forwards to the sibling eyeconic-app backend -- starting ONLY the server leaves every dashboard call returning 503 APP_UNAVAILABLE. Run 'npm run dev' HERE to start the full stack (app backend :3000 + server :5000 + client :5173) via scripts/dev-all.ps1, which verifies each service by an HTTP signature probe.
